target: Largest clipped annotated box by pixel area; ties follow annotation order.
background: Same pixel width and height; first top-to-bottom, left-to-right placement whose rectangle does not overlap any annotated box.
eligibility: Both boxes must fit inside the original image and have nonzero area. Report all other samples as ineligible.
scope: Feasibility only. The comparison of model scores requires a separately fixed fill and scoring procedure.
